Name: Item Research 'n' Spawn Plus (RnS Plus)
Author: TSlex
Description:
[quote][b][color=#f1c232]If you found an incompatibility or bug (or suggestion), please address it on the forum or in the bugs section by creating a new thread, it is easier to track issues there, thank you.[/color][/b][/quote]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/2.0.1/ItemResearchSpawnerV2/nexus/h_description.png[/img]

This is an extension for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8933]Item Research 'n' Spawn mod (RnS)[/url] which currently just adds a progression step before you can use my RnS menu. With this addon installed, you first need to obtain the hungry book itself, before you can use it to "have some fun". I.E. it brings another layer of balance to my RnS mod.

There are currently [b]4 ways[/b] of obtaining the book (the desired one you can choose in mod configuration file)

[list=1]
[*]Craft from all the gems [b][color=#b6d7a8](more early-game unlock)[/color][/b][/*]
[*]Buy from Book seller after Community Centre completion (or paying your bills to the JojaMart cult)[b][color=#6d9eeb] (mid game unlock)[/color][/b][/*]
[*]Buy at Qi shop at Ginger Island [b][color=#8e7cc3](end game unlock)[/color][/b][/*]
[*]Buy from Book seller after visiting The Summit [color=#ffd966][b](after 100% completion)[/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
After that, just use the book to learn the ancient knowlege (and ruin your normal playthrough :D)

You did it, now use the [b][ R ][/b] (or [b][ Y ][/b] on gamepad) to use the [b]RnS menu[/b]!

[i]In future, I planned to make a 5th option - a dedicated quest-line, but I am still learning the power of Content Patcher :P

[/i][b][color=#00ffff]Note: if you want to disable this addon, just [/color]throw [color=#00ffff]the [CP] RnS Plus folder out of the window (or you can disable it in Vortex). [/color][color=#00ff00]The mod uses stats system provided by the game itself, so it is safe to delete at any time.[/color][/b]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/2.0.1/ItemResearchSpawnerV2/nexus/h_install.png[/img]

1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8933]Install Item Research 'n' Spawn (RnS)
[/url]4. Put [b][CP] RnS Plus[/b] folder into Stardew Valley Mods folder
5. Launch the game
